title: Recipes are host-invoked contracts bounded by their declared variant
statement: Every recipe MUST have one canonical source whose manifest validates and whose SKILL.md front matter matches it, its host projections MUST be byte copies of that source with a symlink or a drifted target refusing the whole installation before any write, and every typed operation MUST run only as part of a manifest-declared variant of a known recipe, with an effect no wider than the variant, explicit repository-relative write paths inside the variant write scope for any non-read operation, and an existing materialized file with different bytes reported as drift rather than overwritten.
rationale: ADR-GOV-0020 keeps one canonical recipe source with generated projections, and the recipe contract keeps deterministic work in typed operations whose effects and write scopes the declared variant bounds; a recipe that widens its scope would act outside any authorized boundary.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
